judgments.reasoning_cat1: The class is defined only by reference to Attachments "1" and "2" that are "to be identified" and are not reproduced, so the provision cannot be applied from its own words.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: c057 makes the guarantees apply "only to those individuals listed in Attachments '1' and '2'" while excepting Eligible Group I Employees under paragraph 4B (c017), leaving the membership of the guaranteed class contestable.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: "Guaranteed the opportunity to work five straight time shifts per week" is a soft formulation — an opportunity, not employment — and "the duration of their guarantee period" is defined only elsewhere.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: The guarantee's practical content collides with c018 and c019, which let The Times decline to replace absent RSHs and eliminate vacated situations at its discretion.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: A timing rule keyed to "completion of the process described in paragraph 4B," a process whose completion point is not fixed by any date.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: Paragraph 4B (c017) says replacement continues "during the term of this Agreement," so the process may never be "completed," leaving the effective date of the guarantees uncertain.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: "This provision shall survive the expiration of this Agreement" is a strong perpetual term keyed to employment "in a position that is within the scope of the present NMDU bargaining unit," and "present" bargaining unit scope is itself a contestable boundary.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: Survival sits uneasily with the Appendix A E provisions that suspend or terminate guarantees (c058, c059, c061) and with c001's term ending March 30, 2000.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: "Until the expiration date of the current Collective Bargaining Agreement" is genuinely ambiguous: the original expiry of March 30, 1993 or the extended date of March 30, 2000.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: c001 both describes the CBA as expiring March 30, 1993 and extends it to March 30, 2000, so this clause's endpoint cannot be fixed without choosing between two readings of the preamble; it also contrasts sharply with c054's survival language.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: "Utilize fully the services of Guaranteed Employees ... in inverse seniority order" is odd on its face and "any additional employees" is unbounded.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: Inverse seniority here contrasts with the seniority-based bidding rights preserved in c019, and with the inverse-seniority assignment scheme in the side letter at c076.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: The non-transferability rule is clear but its exception — "except for Eligible Group I Employees who obtain guarantees pursuant to paragraph 4B" — grafts an unlisted class onto an attachment-based scheme.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: c051 and c052 tie guarantees strictly to persons named on Attachments "1" and "2", so the c017/4B entrants have guarantees without an attachment listing.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: Suspension depends on "circumstances under which RSH's are not entitled to be paid under the Collective Bargaining Agreement," a condition whose content lies outside this document.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It qualifies the guarantees in c052 and c054 and depends on the CBA carried forward by c001, so it cannot be applied in isolation.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: "Permanent suspension of the Newspaper" uses a capitalised but undefined term and gives no test for permanence.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It cuts against c054's statement that the Attachment "1" guarantees survive the expiration of the Agreement, and the two termination rules are not sequenced.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: A broad but conventional "for any reason, including but not limited to" exclusion list following termination of employment.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: Consistent with c054 and c055, which condition guarantees on continued employment.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: Termination of guarantees requires a violation that "continues notwithstanding the issuance of a temporary restraining order by a court after a hearing," a multi-step condition with a discretionary "may be terminated at the option of The Times."
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It presupposes an unqualified No-Strike clause, but c027 releases the Union from the no strike-no lockout provision in stated circumstances, so a lawful release could still trip this termination right.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: The me-too right turns on "a wage package which is additional to or different from that contained herein" and on provisos about "productivity improvements or attrition exceeding that which is contained in" the Memorandum or wages "diverted from an existing or subsequently negotiated wage package" — each phrase is vague, and the parenthetical union list raises an expressio unius question.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It overlays the fixed wage schedule in c029-c031 and the arbitrated reopener in c032, and its own arbitration route is the Contract's grievance procedure rather than the Merits Arbitrator scheme in c005.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: A short, concrete undertaking to file papers "promptly upon notification" of ratification.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It appears twice in the instrument in identical terms and conflicts with nothing else.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: "The 43rd Street and/or the staging facility" identifies the carve-out loosely, and "and/or" leaves it unclear whether both are excluded in all cases.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It is a direct qualification of Section 1 (c002, c003, c004), removing facilities from a scheme those clauses state in unqualified terms — exactly the sort of side-letter/operative-text tension that gets litigated.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: "Forty (40) of the current Saturday Night Bulldog finishing times will be assigned to the forty (40) remaining routes" does not say which forty or by what method.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: c021 says the SNBD reorganisation is "subject only to" the forty-route minimum, and c022 fixes start times at no later than 4:00 p.m., so this fixed-finishing-time promise is in tension with both.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: "Shortfalls ... between shift contributions needed to maintain benefits status" and "the Eligible Group I Employees referred to above" both depend on external and undefined measures.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It directs shortfalls to be funded out of the 3.A.(3) contributions, but c011 states those contributions are "in lieu of and not in addition to" other contributions, while c069 and c074 respectively increase and decrease the same pot.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: "Separate contributions" to cover pension shortfalls is stated without amount, rate or method of calculation.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It sits beside the pension percentages and 15.68% cap in c033, and whether these separate contributions count against that cap is unaddressed.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: The condition — "willingness of the individuals involved to avail themselves of all work opportunities that may exist" — is a vague, unmeasured standard governing a payment obligation.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It qualifies both c066 and c067 without specifying who determines willingness or what happens if only some individuals comply.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: The mechanics are confusing on their face: a 450-FTE minimum is increased by "the number of FTE's employed in excess of 370," mixing two different baselines.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: c011 fixes the minimum at 450 FTEs for 1992-1995 while c074 reduces that same figure, so this increase must be reconciled with a reduction operating over the identical years.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: "Dedicated school and college routes may be added as needed" and suspension "or abolished at the discretion of The Times" are open-ended, and the reversion to an 11:30 p.m. start is stated without limit.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: The discretion to abolish routes runs alongside the manning and guarantee provisions (c019, c052) but no direct conflict appears.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: "Will make every effort within its control to insure" is an unmeasurable best-efforts promise, and "bootlegging" is put in quotation marks without definition.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It refers back to NMDU jurisdiction "as provided for in the Collective Bargaining Agreement" carried forward by c001, but nothing in the instrument contradicts it.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: "The appropriate workforce" is undefined and the committee is given no decision rule or tie-breaker for its two-and-two composition.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: Transfers to 43rd Street interact with c064's exclusion of 43rd Street from the new-and-rebuilt-facility scheme, but the committee's remit is administrative only.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: "Specifically charged with administering the transfer process" states a function without any standard or authority to resolve disagreement.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It adds nothing that conflicts with c072 or with the staffing procedures in c076-c080.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: It commits to 1996 contributions while providing that the offsetting reduction "will be evenly distributed throughout the calendar years 1992, 1993, 1994, and 1995" — a reduction applied to years preceding the contributions that generate it.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: c011 fixes those 1992-1995 contributions at a minimum of 450 FTEs and c069 increases the same minimum, so this reduction pulls directly against both.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: An agreement to "take the steps necessary to effectuate amendments" is an agreement to agree, with no content or deadline.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It depends on paragraph 3-A(3) (c011) and this letter, both of which are themselves modified elsewhere.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: "Most junior qualified situation holder" leaves "qualified" undefined, and "pending final award" is a term of art not explained here.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: The procedure applies only "at Edison," which is narrower than the new-and-rebuilt-facility coverage in c002, and interacts with the inverse-seniority utilization rule in c056.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: The last sentence — "They shall be permanently assigned to permanent or vacant positions in the event those situations are not filled by bid" — is awkwardly drafted and sits oddly against the immediately preceding promise of restoration to the former situation.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: c078 states the same permanent-assignment rule again in different words, so the two must be read together to know which governs.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: The sequence is internally muddled: a volunteer is to fill the situation within seven days, yet the same paragraph then provides that if the situation is not filled by bid the most junior qualified holder is permanently assigned and the volunteer returns.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: c076 makes the junior-assignment procedure the primary route while this paragraph makes it conditional on a prior Chapel Chairman step, an ordering the two letters do not fully reconcile.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: "Foreseen to be of two (2) weeks or less duration" depends on a prediction by an unnamed person, though the period itself is definite.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It carves out of c076-c078 in terms that fit those provisions without contradiction.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: A short discretionary option to fill resulting vacancies; "option" is clear.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It coexists with c019's discretion to fill or eliminate vacated situations without evident conflict.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: "The NMDU may, within 72 hours, discuss the possibility of employment opportunities" is close to illusory — the 72 hours runs from an unstated point and no obligation attaches to The Times.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It touches the RSH list and manning provisions (c016, c017) only obliquely and contradicts nothing.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: A concrete grievance settlement identifying position, days off and start time.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: Nothing elsewhere addresses M. Santor or dispatcher assignments.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: A single sentence withdrawing a grievance with prejudice for stated consideration.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: Pairs cleanly with c082 and conflicts with nothing.
